title: P104: classify all scalar helper relations in the MOVE40710 plane
body:
## Summary
Uniform exact classification of scalar promise lines and the full plane spanned by e885-e705 and e1459, with unchanged #7481 histories.

## Result
All lines involving e885-e705 give only rank-8 cache40710; the e1459-only line gives rank-1 cache52236; the full plane gives both. No other caches or zero MOVEs; original-target debits remove other credits.

## Verification
Exact support/circuit proof, modular full-rank certificate, independent replay and 11 mutation controls. Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-public-relation-family-bound`.

## Scope and kappa
Transport corollary needs initial correlated 1459 to be unavailable for free and paid cross-frame whole jobs. Other planes, changed producers and block promises open. No new kappa. All five foundational assumptions remain.

## Credit and details
#7481 and earlier published history/price results credited. Prepared for @CubeJerry with OpenAI assistance; original notices retained. See `research/p104-public-relation-family-bound/PR-DESCRIPTION.md` and `VALIDATION.json` for full proof, pins and controls.
